name: Lord
abilityText: Decree (action, once per round): gain 2 of any one resource.
siegeText: Rally: once per siege round, in Recovery, +2 Defense to one lane next round. If the Lord falls, defenders lose.

name: Architect
passiveText: Walls, gates and towers cost 1 less Stone when the Architect builds them.
siegeText: Repair: once per siege round, in Recovery, restore 2 HP to one wall or gate.

name: Quartermaster
abilityText: Requisition (action, once per round): trade up to 3 resources at 1:1.
siegeText: Resupply: once per siege round, one lane's defender ranged effects get +1 damage.

name: Knight
abilityText: Raid (exclusive action): sortie from a gate with up to 2 troops.
passiveText: Training troops costs 1 less Gold when the Knight trains them.
siegeText: The Knight is a unit (Strength 2, HP 3) that can move to any bailey each round. If defeated, it returns to the Keep after 1 round.
